products.name: Asymmetric Zip Collar Top
products.description: A statement long-sleeve top featuring an oversized asymmetric collar, zip-front construction and lace-up detailing near the hem. The washed taupe and grey visual treatment gives the piece an experimental Japanese-streetwear character.

primary.alt: Asymmetric Zip Collar Top, Taupe / Grey

products.name: Draped Utility Wide Trousers
products.description: Wide-leg trousers featuring a relaxed silhouette and a distinctive draped wrap-style panel around the upper leg. Designed as a statement oversized bottom for layered streetwear styling.

primary.alt: Draped Utility Wide Trousers, Khaki / Taupe

products.name: Washed Lace-Up Pointed Shirt
products.description: A washed blue-grey long-sleeve shirt with an elongated pointed silhouette and lace-up detailing. Pale cuffs contrast against the distressed printed body.

primary.alt: Washed Lace-Up Pointed Shirt, Washed Blue / Grey

products.name: Check Buckle Mini Skirt
products.description: A statement check mini skirt combining a light-blue and red checked pattern with an oversized buckle belt and asymmetrical handkerchief-style hem.

primary.alt: Check Buckle Mini Skirt, Light Blue / Red

products.name: Sheer Floral Lace-Up Top
products.description: A lightweight-looking sheer sleeveless top featuring floral embroidery and adjustable lace-up detailing along the sides. Designed as a layering-focused statement piece.

primary.alt: Sheer Floral Lace-Up Top, Off White

products.name: Charcoal Pleated Balloon Trousers
products.description: Relaxed charcoal trousers with deep pleats and a dramatic balloon-leg silhouette. The oversized shape gives the piece a strong contemporary streetwear profile.

primary.alt: Charcoal Pleated Balloon Trousers, Charcoal / Black

products.name: Acid Wash Gothic Hooded Top
products.description: A sleeveless hooded top featuring an acid-washed grey appearance, eyelet details and a gothic-inspired graphic across the front.

primary.alt: Acid Wash Gothic Hooded Top, Grey / Acid Wash

products.name: Faded Black Wide-Leg Jeans
products.description: Wide-leg black denim featuring a faded wash and visible seam detailing. The relaxed proportions create an oversized streetwear silhouette.

primary.alt: Faded Black Wide-Leg Jeans, Faded Black

products.name: Layered Pinstripe Waffle Shirt
products.description: A short-sleeve black pinstripe shirt styled over a contrasting light-grey long-sleeve layer, creating a layered streetwear look with contrasting textures.
features: Short sleeve over long waffle sleeve

primary.alt: Layered Pinstripe Waffle Shirt, Black / Light Grey

products.name: Grey Pleated Drawstring Trousers
products.description: Relaxed grey trousers combining wide proportions with pleated construction and a drawstring waist. Designed around a loose, oversized silhouette.

primary.alt: Grey Pleated Drawstring Trousers, Grey

products.name: Flame Print Washed Zip Hoodie
products.description: A charcoal-washed zip hoodie featuring contrasting flame graphics along the sleeves. The oversized streetwear profile makes it suitable as a statement outer layer.

primary.alt: Flame Print Washed Zip Hoodie, Charcoal / Magenta / Cream

products.name: Flame Edge Wide Joggers
products.description: Wide charcoal-wash joggers featuring contrasting flame artwork near the lower leg. Designed to pair visually with oversized streetwear tops and hoodies.

primary.alt: Flame Edge Wide Joggers, Charcoal / Magenta / Cream

products.name: Red Plaid Layered Graphic Top
products.description: A layered statement top combining a black base with a red graphic lace-up panel, red plaid sleeves and a mesh layer for a multi-texture streetwear look.

primary.alt: Red Plaid Layered Graphic Top, Black / Red / Grey

products.name: Red Star Wide Utility Shorts
products.description: Relaxed wide shorts featuring a contrasting red star panel, vertical black-and-white stripes and a drawstring waist.

primary.alt: Red Star Wide Utility Shorts, Light Grey / Red / Black

products.name: Hook Closure Cropped Jacket
products.description: A cropped dark jacket with a structured stand collar, metal hook-style closures and a chest pocket detail. Designed around a compact, industrial-inspired silhouette.

primary.alt: Hook Closure Cropped Jacket, Black / Charcoal

products.name: Faded Navy Stand-Collar Jacket
products.description: A faded navy-and-black zip jacket featuring a stand collar, metal hook closures and a small chest detail. Its washed appearance gives it a worn-in streetwear aesthetic.

primary.alt: Faded Navy Stand-Collar Jacket, Navy / Black

products.name: Olive Balloon Utility Trousers
products.description: Oversized olive-green trousers with a balloon-leg silhouette and adjustable drawstring detailing. Built visually around volume and relaxed proportions.

primary.alt: Olive Balloon Utility Trousers, Olive Green

products.name: Navy Side-Tie Boxy Top
products.description: A sleeveless boxy top in deep navy and black featuring side-tie details. Its simple construction works as a foundation piece for layered styling.

primary.alt: Navy Side-Tie Boxy Top, Navy / Black

products.name: Oversized White Shirt
products.description: A clean oversized white shirt designed around a relaxed silhouette. Its minimal appearance allows it to work as a standalone piece or as a layering base.

primary.alt: Oversized White Shirt, White

products.name: Check Sash Balloon Trousers
products.description: Black balloon trousers featuring a contrasting black-and-white checked sash detail. The exaggerated silhouette gives the piece a strong editorial streetwear profile.

primary.alt: Check Sash Balloon Trousers, Black / White

products.name: Striped Frog-Button Layered Shirt
products.description: A cropped blue-and-white striped shirt featuring distinctive knotted frog-style buttons and layered styling over a white long-sleeve base.

primary.alt: Striped Frog-Button Layered Shirt, Blue / White

products.name: Dark Denim Pleated Balloon Trousers
products.description: Dark denim trousers combining pleated construction with an oversized balloon silhouette. Designed as a statement bottom with a structured yet relaxed appearance.

primary.alt: Dark Denim Pleated Balloon Trousers, Dark Denim
